classification.explanation: The AXP2101 address probe and chip-id read succeed. The next failing Python read issues an address-0x51 transaction that receives no ACK and does not produce another address-0x34 controller transaction. Address 0x51 plus the frozen BM8563 qstrs and the disable_timer_interrupt/read_byte stack strongly identify an RTC-candidate path. The first confirmed gap is therefore controller-to-board-bus routing or handoff, not an AXP register-response mismatch.
